title: 30-Day Friendship Challenge
h1: You keep meaning to see people more. Give it thirty days and one small drill a day.
sub: A thirty-day calendar with a named drill each day, from saying hello to hosting. Low stakes first, no forced networking.
preview_alts: 30-Day Friendship Challenge page 2: a thirty-day calendar with a named drill for each day

uvp.p: A named drill for each of thirty days, on one calendar you can stick on a wall.
A page says what to do for each day, so you are not guessing.
The early days are small. The later days build up to hosting.

stat.t: of adults aged 30-44 are frequently or always lonely, the highest of any age group. Friendship skills are habits, and habits come from repetition in low-stakes rooms.

benefits.h: A plan for the days you would skip
benefits.p: The calendar names the drill, so you do not have to decide what to do.
Each week has a theme and a Sunday prompt, so you can see what moved.
The drills are small and ordinary. They are not about collecting contacts.

benefits.h: A path to the full practice
benefits.p: If thirty days works, The 30-Day Friendship Practice adds scripts and a tracker.
